summary.purpose: B3 remainder + P1 playtest item: 組織經驗甲's printed clause "每從手上棄掉1張購買費用4點以上的牌，可重複上述動作1次" had no implementation, and playtest reported the missing confirmation flow. Now after each build resolves, if the hand holds any card whose purchase cost totals >=4 AND a legal build town exists (supply limit / distance restrictions included), an explicit confirm prompt opens (不再建立 / 棄1張再建立1次); accepting opens a card choice limited to qualifying cards, discarding reopens the build town choice with the same effect context (so 新疆社會管控's inner 1-step downgrade carries through), looping until the player declines or runs out of qualifying cards/towns. Declining or lacking qualifiers never auto-consumes anything.
